text:
adrian cole: Quick proposal: run a micro PLG experiment 'quickstart-velocity' — short launch posts + 2-step credit top-up + 15-min webinar. Objective: speed up time-to-first-run (TTFR) to under 6 hours. Small sample. Thoughts?
kelly tran: love it. keep it lean: 500 impressions, seed 100 users. stagger credits: 10 on signup, +30 after first prompt-run. Who owns routing and cohort tags?
adrian cole: @morgan can you own routing? @diego can do copy. I'll handle webinar logistics.
morgan li: Yep. Plan: tag users with query param `utm_campaign=qs_velocity`. Pseudocode: 
```
if (utm_campaign == 'qs_velocity') {
  user.meta.cohort = 'qs_velocity_v1';
  emit('qs.credit_seeded');
}
```
diego ruiz: Copy brief: pragmatic + fast. Headline: "Get started with starter prompts — credits included" Offer: "10 credits now + 30 when you run your first template" Email A: "10 credits to get you started" Email B: "Run a starter prompt, get +30 credits" Social: short dev-oriented caption + sample prompt screenshot.
ux-bot: Reminder: campaign scheduling requires 48h lead time. Add check for job window.
kelly tran: UX asks: post-signup success page should show a pre-selected template and a big CTA: "Run sample prompt". Also add an in-flow mini-tour that suggests the top-up reward. I can push a staging variant today.
adrian cole: Measurement: funnel = impression -> signup -> first prompt-run (6h) -> top-up -> second prompt-run. Key metrics: TTFR median, prompt-run rate within 6h, retention 24h. Gate: if prompt-run < 35% at 24h, pause.
morgan li: Tech notes: backend will grant initial 10 credits at create; on event `prompt.run:first` call credits.grant(+30) and emit `qs.topup`. Will expose cohort_id `qs_velocity_v1` to analytics. I'll open a tiny PR.
diego ruiz: Drafting 3 starter prompts focused on quick wins: 1) summarizer 2) code completion starter 3) instant prompt for app idea. Will post copy in #marketing-drafts by noon.
kelly tran: Also propose a small in-app nudge: if user signs up and doesn't run prompt within 3 hours, show an in-app banner with one-click "Run sample prompt". Should help TTFR.
scheduling-bot: Check scheduled: please confirm final launch time at least 48 hours before send.
adrian cole: Timeline: prep today, soft launch Wed 11am PT to 500 impressions, measure 72h. Webinar Thurs 10am PT — 15-min demo + 10 Qs. Decision: scale to 5k impressions if TTFR median drops below 6h and prompt-run rate increases >=15%.
morgan li: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1102 (routing + top-up hook).
diego ruiz: Drafts posted in #marketing-drafts: short social A/B and both email subjects.
kelly tran: Staging landing up at /qs-velocity-staging. Success page wired with preselected prompt and CTA.
adrian cole: Good. Go ahead with 100 users x staged credits. Keep it tight and instrumented. Thanks team! :rocket:
